message.action_label: Create an account or log in

clauses.quote: You must be a human to create an Account. Accounts registered by "bots" or other automated methods are not permitted. We do permit machine accounts:
You further agree not to impose technical or other targeted measures to restrict or retaliate against such Access.

clauses.section: Is GitHub Copilot intended to fully automate code generation and replace developers?
clauses.quote: Moreover, you should make sure your code editor or editor does not automatically compile or run generated code before you review it.
You may maintain no more than one free machine account in addition to your free Personal Account.
Your login may only be used by one person — i.e., a single login may not be shared by multiple people.
Run reusable agent tasks on demand, on a schedule, or from supported triggers.

A machine account is an Account set up by an individual human who accepts the Terms on behalf of the Account, provides a valid email address, and is responsible for its actions. A machine account is used exclusively for performing automated tasks.
for automated scanning or manual review for known vulnerabilities, active malware, or other content known to violate our Terms of Service;
